behaviorChanges: new `tautline product-dev-mode on|off|status` verb + per-checkout .ai-work/PRODUCT_DEV_MODE.json state with a 240-min TTL auto-expiry; INERT (no hook or gate reads it yet); all shepherding and code-safety behavior unchanged

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.7 removes the inert product-dev-mode verb and state reader; the gitignored .ai-work/PRODUCT_DEV_MODE.json is simply ignored by older runtimes (no hook or gate ever read it) and no on-disk state moves in either direction.
